reviews.title: Difficult and Glitchy
reviews.text: It was difficult to share this calendar with someone, i instead had to use my pc to do it. it also sucked at syncing— tasks on my phone were completely different than the ones on my other devices

Cannot talk to anyone except thur emails !!!
Takes days for a response back . Then the response is unhelpful or doesn’t have anything to do with your problem !!!

reviews.title: App doesn’t work
reviews.text: I have double and triple checked my username and password dozens of times and it still wont let me past the login page. It resets the login process every time I click submit. No error message, no successful sign-in message. Just straight back to, “Input Username” upon every time I successfully enter username and password.
